name: Sit-Down Breakfast Smoked Salmon (Lox), Toasted White Bagel & Cream Cheese
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Treasure · 1923
whyItWorks: Cold-smoked Atlantic salmon over a toasted plain white bagel provides anti-inflammatory omega-3s and zero-residue carbs.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Use a light smear of cream cheese (with a Lactaid) or plain butter, and leave the raw red onion rings, capers, and lemon wedge untouched.
watchOuts: Discard lemon wedge, raw red onions, and capers
